author: TEDx Talks
description:
For thirty years, Maks Giordano helped companies find faster, smarter, creative paths into the future. Then AI arrived and raised a question he could not ignore: when machines become extraordinary at optimization, what remains uniquely human?

Drawing on a forgotten 1966 “documentary about the future,” Keith Jarrett’s broken piano, the birth of punk, and the strange history of human discovery, Maks explores the one thing no machine can do for us: decide what is worth pursuing in the first place. 

In a world obsessed with speed, this talk asks a different question: What deserves the speed? Maks Giordano is a digital creative strategist and innovation specialist with more than 30 years of experience leading innovation projects for iconic brands. He works at the intersection of exponential technologies and practical innovation, recognised both for his thinking on generative AI and for the hands-on work of applying it to transform industries and business models.

He has served as a manag
title: Why AI shouldn’t decide our future | Maks Giordano | TEDxBerlin

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens when growing up changes not just the child, but the parent too? In this personal and emotional talk, Valerie Woo explores what happens as young adults begin choosing lives of their own while their parents learn to step back, trust, and find a new way to stay connected.
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala). Dr. Valerie Woo is a pediatric dentist, entrepreneur, speaker, and proud daughter of Filipino immigrants. Through her work and personal story, she explores what it means to grow, lead, and become yourself in seasons of change. On the TEDxHSRW stage, Valerie will share the heart behind Half Nester, a concept born from her own life long before motherhood. Through that lens, she speaks to the in-between space so many students know well: between home and independence, family expectations and personal identity, ambition and belonging. With warmth, honesty, and insight, Valerie invites the audience to rethink what it means to be limitless, not by doing more or b
title: Growing Up Without Growing Apart | Dr. Valerie Woo | TEDxHSRW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Before a human recruiter reads a single word, an algorithm may already have said no. Most of us conclude we weren't good enough. After eight years of mentoring young professionals, Pradeep sees a different gap: not skills, but visibility. Through two short stories, a student from Montenegro and a master's student from India, he shows how they moved forward without a perfect CV. What changed things was one person who knew their story, understood it, and chose to help. Germans call it "Vitamin B." Pradeep calls it recognition, and it starts with being willing to be seen. At TEDxHSRW, he makes the case that in an age when algorithms decide who gets seen, the story you haven't yet told might be the most powerful thing you own. 
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala). Dr. Pradeep Ghosh's journey abroad as a young student began with strangers who welcomed him like family - a kindness that showed him how a single human story can open doors that no credential ever could. Today, as
title: What if the only limit was…you haven’t told your story yet? | Dr. Pradeep Ghosh | TEDxHSRW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
NOTE FROM TED: This talk only represents the speaker’s personal views and understanding of technology and addiction. This TEDx event was independently organized by volunteers by and for a youth audience. The guidelines we give TEDx organizers are described in more detail here: http://storage.ted.com/tedx/manuals/tedx_content_guidelines.pdf

Later than most parents think: Giovanni Carlozzi went through middle school without a phone and credits that with his confidence and people skills. While his friends had devices and social media, he spent his free time deep sea fishing and camping on islands in the Florida Keys with his family. He didn’t understand his parents’ rules until he noticed classmates who found the outdoors boring and kids glued to their phones at their own birthday parties. His parents also pushed him to greet adults and start conversations first, a habit he says put him on the TEDx stage. For parents deciding when to hand over a phone, and teens who think they’re missin
title: Prioritizing family quality time over screen time | Giovanni Carlozzi | TEDxMiramar Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Ranika has spent years inside healthcare systems, from running weight loss clinics in the U.S. to the Netherlands, and kept seeing the same gap between protocols and the people they were meant to help. In this talk, she shares that story and the science behind it with leaders, parents, and anyone who has cared for someone else. What’s eroding our health, our teams, and our families was never a discipline problem; it was always a disconnection problem.
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala). Ranika Koneru has spent years inside the systems meant to help people heal, and watched them fall short in the same quiet way every time. From running weight loss clinics in the U.S. to starting Origynz Longevity in the Netherlands, she kept finding the same distance between the protocols and the people inside them. 

Today she brings that story, and the science behind it, to leaders, parents, and anyone who has ever tried to take care of someone else. 
Because what’s slowly eroding our
title: Who knows you are here today? | Ranika Koneru | TEDxHSRW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Every system you move through was shaped by someone who is no longer there, for a world that has already changed. That's what a coffee shop has in common with a startup or university. 
We treat these shapes as the way things are and work inside them until the costs become too high. Aleks Kireeva on how to see the shape you inherited, and why you have the power to redesign it.
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala). Aleks Kireeva is a senior commercial operator who has spent fifteen years rebuilding operations at European fintechs and B2B SaaS companies. She currently leads Commercial Analytics for a €1.5 billion vertical at Delivery Hero, after earlier roles at Billie, Smava, and Neugelb, Commerzbank's digital subsidiary.
Her thesis is that companies aren't machines, even though we keep designing them like they are. The constraints that look permanent inside organisations: the queues, the silos, the rules everyone has accepted as "just how things work here", are almost alw
title: The shape you never chose is running your day | Aleksandra Kireeva | TEDxHSRW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the effort AI saves you is the very effort you need? From programming an app to avoid homework to preparing this TEDx talk with AI, Winston Nau shares a personal, humorous story about his love of shortcuts — and the moment one made him question his own thinking. He explores the difference between the effort that wastes our time and the effort that helps us grow, asking how we can embrace AI while keeping our ideas truly our own.
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala). At nine years old, Winston Nau was not dreaming of becoming a founder, developer, or AI speaker. He was dreaming of one thing: never having to pause his video games.

What started as a child’s attempt to make life easier soon became something much bigger: a fascination with coding, automation, and artificial intelligence. Winston began programming at a young age, explored AI long before ChatGPT became a global phenomenon, worked with international clients as a teenager, and now builds real-world AI so
title: When AI Makes Thinking Optional | Winston Nau | TEDxHSRW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How much can lived experience influence research when the key decisions have already been made? Drawing on personal experience and her community-engaged work with Tai Chi Prime, Dr Ejura Yetunde Salihu explores how the timing of people’s involvement shapes what their insights can change. She invites us to rethink when we listen to the people our research, programmes and health services are intended to serve.
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala).

The Tai Chi Prime randomised trial referenced in this talk was conducted between 2016 and 2017. The findings were first published online in 2019 and later included in the June 2020 issue of The Gerontologist. Link to article: https://academic.oup.com/gerontologist/article/60/4/765/5366273 Dr. Ejura Yetunde Salihu is a health services researcher and implementation scientist whose work explores how communities, healthcare professionals, and researchers can work together to improve health outcomes and reduce health inequalities. Ha
title: Listening changes what we learn | Dr. Ejura Salihu | TEDxHSRW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens to your day when we fall asleep? Neuroscientist Dr. Abdel Rayan explores how sleep helps the brain stabilize, reorganize, and integrate memories, turning the day’s experiences into tomorrow's memories. The talk shows that sleep isn't a passive break or wasted time, but an active process in which the brain uses experience to make memories last.
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala). Dr. Abdel Rayan is a neuroscientist and founder with a broad background spanning medicine, systems neuroscience, computational neuroscience, and mathematical modelling. His work explores how the brain reorganizes its activity as it moves between wakefulness and sleep, and how these changing brain states support memory consolidation.
At Radboud University and Radboudumc in Nijmegen, he uses AI and machine learning to explore sleep states across species, bridging animal and human sleep research to better understand how the brain processes experience and memories during sleep.
In his
title: Sleep to Remember: How Sleep Shapes Our Memories | Dr. Abdelrahman Rayan | TEDxHSRW

description: In a world where the things we love, choose, and pursue begin to look alike, how much of who we are is truly authentic? With “How Identity Survives”, Dinh Minh Anh brings a unique take on that question: she invites us to revisit the origins of our identity and explore ways to preserve the unique qualities that define us as individuals. author: TEDx Talks
description:
In her talk, Antje explores the power of reclaiming your voice as a catalyst for personal transformation, professional growth and meaningful connection. Her work is shaped by her own journey from a once near-silent child with selective mutism to a calmly confident leader, poet and performer. She shows that assertiveness is not loudness but self‑respect in action and that no matter your past, you can rebuild, rise and reclaim your voice.
Filmed and edited by Fotocinema (Arkadiusz Tomala). Dr Antje Bothin is an assertive communication coach, trauma‑informed trainer and published author of several books based in Scotland. Originally from Germany, she writes poetry and stories about nature and wellbeing highlighting the resilience found in everyday life. Drawing on her academic background and lived experience, she helps people to find their voice, shine their light and speak with calm authority in high‑stakes conversations. As the founder of Assertive Voices, she empowers individuals to r
title: Finding Your Voice: From Silence to Self-Expression | Dr. Antje Bothin | TEDxHSRW

description: Sometimes, just because of several mishaps, we are quick to say we are not good enough or not suitable for something. With “The Identity Trap”, Nguyen Nhu Mai explores how failures and negative thoughts can gradually undermine how we perceive ourselves, and a way to break free of that prison. Art is the shared gift of humankind, and the embodiment of the endless curiosity that only we have. Creating art is the strongest way to reclaim your attention span and awaken the depth in our own mindset. author: TEDx Talks
description:
Human beings are inherently small entities, and we often dream of shining like stars or leaving a monumental mark on the world. However, through his talk on the feeling of emptiness, Hung Hiep hopes to help people recognize the beauty in even the smallest actions, for we are the ones who create meaning in our own lives.  Nguyễn Hưng Hiệp, a content creator for Neo Impact and the "Nhà Nhiều Cột" project, has garnered significant support and interest from young people thanks to his meaningful content. Beyond this, he has distinguished himself through the following achievements and experiences: 
- Graduated as the top student (Valedictorian) of the Multimedia Communications program at FPT University Hanoi. 
- Champion and Best Speaker at Room XX Debate 2024 (organized by UNDP in Vietnam). 
- Ranked in the Top 2 and Top 3 for Outstanding Research at the FPT EDU Research Festival in 2022 and 2021 (organized by FPT Education). This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference for
title: That Meaningful Meaninglessness | Hung Hiep Nguyen | TEDxHanoi Amsterdam Youth

Minh Anh’s talk confronts this phenomenon, inviting us to step away from this cycle of "guessing intentions“. She encourages us to realize that sometimes, the key to being understood is simply speaking up about what we truly need. author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the greatest threat to humanity is not our differences, but our increasing reluctance to engage with those who differ from us?
We live in an age defined by labels. Race, gender, nationality, class, religion, and politics increasingly shape how we perceive one another. In South Africa, xenophobia, racial tension, and debates surrounding identity remind us how quickly categories become barriers. The more we retreat into our respective groups, the easier it becomes to fear, misunderstand, or dehumanise those outside them.
My central argument is simple: societies do not heal through avoidance. They heal through engagement. Beyond one-to-one engagement, which is ideal, live comedy and theatre offer opportunities we have not fully tapped into.
 Krijay Govender has been voted by the media as the funniest woman in South Africa and has been rated one of the top three MCs (Gwen Gill, Sunday Times). She works extensively hosting local and international events for government, business and
title: The Anatomy of a Good Story. | Krijay Govender | TEDxUniversity of Johannesburg

author: TEDx Talks
description: The talk, titled Faith Is Not Fearless. It's Forward, explores how the binary we hold between faith, and fear shapes the decisions we make, the lives we stay in, and the leadership we accept. It draws on lived experience across career transitions and cross-continental change and engages directly with how this binary manifests in African and diasporic contexts. Author. Marketing Strategist. Growth Leader. Bami Iroko supports early-stage startups and enterprise companies across technology, publishing, finance, entertainment, and the arts. author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the key to navigating an unpredictable future isn't predicting the next wave, but building the ability to ride it? Drawing on 35 years of leadership experience and a personal story of overcoming adversity, this talk introduces a new way to think about readiness: prepare to adapt, build for uncertainty, and turn disruption into opportunity. Darius T. Evans, Sr. is an accomplished entertainment executive, producer, and strategist with over two decades of experience in film, television, and media. He currently serves as President/Chief Operating Officer of Contenu Entertainment, where he oversees development and physical production across a diverse slate of projects.

As Co-President of the Georgia Production Partnership (GPP), Darius plays a pivotal role in advancing Georgia’s entertainment industry. He works closely with government leaders, studios, and industry partners to strengthen the state’s competitive position through policy, workforce development, and community engageme
title: Riding the waves of disruption  | Darius Evans | TEDxBuckheadAve

description: HOW TECHNOLOGY USED RESPONSIBLY IS HELPING TREAT NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS Dr. Anshu Rohatgi is a highly distinguished Senior Consultant Neurologist and currently serves as the ViceChairperson of the Department of Neurology at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital, New Delhi. With over three decades of clinical mastery, he is widely recognized as one of India’s foremost authorities in comprehensive neurological care. His extensive expertise encompasses a broad spectrum of complex neurovascular and movement disorders, including hyper-acute stroke management, stroke thrombolysis, Parkinson’s disease, advanced epilepsy, neuroimmunology, and severe neuromuscular conditions. Dr. Rohatgi is deeply committed to delivering evidence-based, patient-centric treatment protocols, seamlessly bridging cutting-edge neurological science with compassionate bedside clinical care. title: BEYOND THE SCALPEL HEALING THE BRAIN WITH SOUND | Dr Anshu Rohatgi | TEDxIPEC

author: TEDx Talks
description: A ajuns pe scena TEDx, spune el, „pentru niște urechi”, nu pentru foie gras, trufe sau caviar. Octavian Băloi, bucătar venit în Constanța acum 21 de ani și rămas aici, povestește ce a învățat din Spania despre mândria față de ce pui pe masă și de ce Dobrogea, cu turcii, tătarii, grecii, lipovenii și aromânii ei, cu peștele din Marea Neagră, brânzeturile și vinurile ei, are o identitate gastronomică de care încă nu suntem mândri. Viitorul, crede el, are mai puțin spectacol și mai mult gust: producători plătiți corect, oameni formați în bucătărie și curajul de a construi din rădăcini, nu de a fugi de ele. Octavian Băloi este bucătar-șef și omul din spatele RozMarine Tapas & Vin, restaurantul deschis în 2022 în Piața Ovidiu, în Constanța veche. Restaurantul a crescut din doi ani de „Bucătărie la Vedere”, în care echipa gătea sub ochii oaspeților. Gătește din pasiune, construiește din încăpățânare și crede că cele mai bune povești încep în jurul unei mese. Pornește de la bucătăria mediter
title: Despre rădăcini, curaj și viitorul gastronomiei | Octavian Băloi | TEDxConstanta

author: TEDx Talks
description: Zece secunde în care nu înțelegi ce ți se spune: așa începe Erwin Șimșensohn, în limba semnelor române, și așa arată o viață întreagă pentru comunitatea surzilor din Constanța. Prin ochii a trei oameni, Ana, în scaun rulant, Mihai, care e surd, și Elena, nevăzătoare, arată cum o bordură de 15 centimetri, o rampă lipsă sau un PDF scanat devin ziduri, iar problema nu e omul, ci orașul construit fără el. Din teatru, unde a început să întrebe „cine lipsește din sală?”, vine cu trei cereri simple pentru fiecare dintre noi, până la cea mai ușoară: nu parcați pe bordura coborâtă, nici măcar două minute. Erwin Șimșensohn este regizor și, din 2019, directorul general al Teatrului de Stat Constanța, pe care l-a transformat într-un reper al teatrului românesc: membru al European Theatre Convention și nominalizat la Premiile UNITER șase ani la rând. Absolvent de regie al UNATC „I.L. Caragiale”, a montat spectacole pe scene din toată țara și a fost secretar de stat în Ministerul Culturii. Este fon
title: Bariere invizibile: teatre, orașe și cei care rămân pe dinafară | Erwin Șimșensohn | TEDxConstanta

author: TEDx Talks
description: De ce le spunem tinerilor că vocea lor contează, dar îi chemăm abia după ce decizia s-a luat? Elena-Alexandra Miron, care a vorbit în numele tinerilor în fața unor șefi de stat, vorbește pentru prima dată acasă, la Constanța, despre trei idei: vocea se învață în familie, la școală și în comunitate, nu la 18 ani; drepturi egale nu înseamnă acces egal; iar participarea are sens doar când ai un loc real înainte de decizie, nu doar un loc în poză. 57% dintre tinerii din România au încercat să schimbe ceva, cel mai mare procent din Uniunea Europeană, iar răspunsul pe care îl primesc prea des este cel din titlu. Elena-Alexandra Miron este cercetătoare în domeniul climei, energiei și sustenabilității, cofondatoare și președintă a Platformei Tinerilor pentru Sustenabilitate. A reprezentat tinerii din România la Conferințele ONU privind Schimbările Climatice COP27, COP28, COP29 și COP30. Este Tânără Ambasadoare pentru Energie la nivel european, organizatoare regională pentru Europa Centrală și
title: Dragi tineri, mulțumim pentru opinie. Revenim noi. | Elena-Alexandra Miron | TEDxConstanta

What if every student had a learning plan designed around their unique gifts?

This talk challenges traditional approaches to education and introduces the Individualized Gifted Program (IGP), a framework that puts students' strengths, passions, and voices at the center of learning.

Discover how recognizing each student's potential could transform the way we educate children—and the futures we help them imagine. Dr. Rukiya Jeffers Ware is a leadership consultant, educator, executive coach, and international athlete whose work explores how people grow, adapt, and perform across different stages of life. Her two-decade career spans education, technology, special education, organizational leadership, and consulting, including graduate-level instruction at Teachers College, Columbia University. Beyond her professional work, she is a Team USA Masters Track & Field athlete and World Masters Championships silver medalist, bringing firsthand experience with reinvention, discipline, and high p
title: You’re on the Right Track, Stay the Course  | Rukiya Ware | TEDxThunder Hill

author: TEDx Talks
description: Ce rămâne după noi, dacă moștenirea nu începe atunci când plecăm, ci cu ce alegem să facem azi? Antreprenoarea Anca Stebingăr pornește de la copilăria din Maramureș și de la nevoia de apartenență, trece prin visul de a deveni arhitect, ratat la admitere și împlinit altfel, și ajunge la un depozit din 1906 din Constanța, transformat într-un loc în care o industrie întreagă lucrează împreună. Ideea ei: lucrurile mari nu se construiesc singur, iar cu cât lumea devine mai artificială, cu atât umanitatea valorează mai mult. Anca Stebingăr este antreprenoare, General Manager al SAS Group și cofondatoare a Avram Iancu 17 — Smart Urban Regeneration, un hub creativ și tehnic din Constanța. Pentru ea, business-ul nu a fost niciodată doar despre cifre, procese sau rezultate. Contează și acestea, dar adevărata diferență o fac echipele, relațiile dintre oameni, încrederea pe care o construiesc și sensul pe care îl dau muncii lor. Crede că cele mai valoroase proiecte sunt cele care continuă să prod
title: Ce rămâne după noi? | Anca Stebingăr | TEDxConstanta

author: TEDx Talks
description: Ce îi face pe oameni înțelepți, nu doar isteți? Andrei Stupu, cercetător al inteligenței etico-morale și fost bursier Fulbright la Harvard, lasă deoparte teoriile și vorbește despre ce l-a învățat cu adevărat despre bine: poezia, recunoștința și curajul de a vedea frumusețea acolo unde pare să nu existe. Pentru el, orice act moral începe cu o întrebare pusă din curiozitate și cu prezența, atenția pe care chiar o dăm celor din jur. Dr. Andrei Stupu este cercetător specializat în studierea inteligenței, teoreticianul conceptului de inteligență etico-morală și fost cercetător Fulbright la Universitatea Harvard. Are un doctorat în Științe ale Educației cu cotutelă în Filosofie, la Universitatea Babeș-Bolyai și Universitatea din București. Este profesor de mindfulness format la Oxford Mindfulness Foundation și Patron al International Values-based Education Trust. Este Director Academic al Dialogue for Democracy & Development Southeast Europe Foundation și profesor asociat la Facultatea de
title: Binele în acțiune: de la intenție la curaj moral | Andrei Stupu | TEDxConstanta

author: TEDx Talks
description: De ce plătim mai mult pentru un obiect care are o poveste și de ce istoria nu e doar o listă de date? Istoricul Georgiana Țăranu arată cum trecutul acționează în noi și în jurul nostru: în Constanța, născută între turci, tătari, greci, lipoveni, aromâni, armeni, evrei și romi, în obiceiurile de zi cu zi și în frica pe care războaiele o lasă în familii timp de generații. Încheie cu o invitație pe dos: să fim mereu sceptici când cineva invocă istoria ca să justifice o acțiune. Georgiana Țăranu este istoric și lector universitar la Facultatea de Istorie și Științe Politice a Universității „Ovidius” din Constanța. Doctor în istorie al Institutului „Nicolae Iorga” al Academiei Române, a cercetat în arhive din România și Italia, inclusiv în Arhiva Vaticanului. Este autoarea volumului „Nicolae Iorga și seducția fascismului italian” (Humanitas, 2025), nominalizat pe lista scurtă la Premiul „Monica Lovinescu” 2025. Crede în datoria istoricilor de a vorbi pe înțelesul publicului larg și organiz
title: Istoria ca verb: cum acționează trecutul | Georgiana Țăranu | TEDxConstanta

author: TEDx Talks
description: Câte fotografii cu noi am șters doar pentru că nu ne-am plăcut în ele? Fotografa Teodora Peneș, care a avut în fața aparatului aproape 300 de femei, vorbește despre filtrele de înfrumusețare din telefoane, despre măștile pe care le purtăm ca să fim acceptați și despre cum obiectivul măsoară stima de sine, nu doar frumusețea. Ne lasă un exercițiu pentru seara asta: un minut în fața oglinzii, o îmbrățișare, abia apoi o fotografie, fără filtru. Teodora Peneș este artist vizual și antreprenor, fondatoarea brandurilor Atemporalia și Dora Boudoir, dedicate imaginii reale și brandingului personal feminin. În 2025 a lansat revista „Femeile Orașului Meu”, ajunsă la două ediții, Constanța și Satu Mare, un proiect care pune în lumină curajul, poveștile și forța interioară a femeilor antreprenoare. Parcursul ei a pornit din dorința de a fi aproape de oameni și de a spune adevărul fără filtre. Fotografia ei nu înseamnă supraeditare, ci puterea de a te privi cu iubire și de a fi conștientă de propr
title: Curajul de a sta față în față cu tine | Teodora Peneș | TEDxConstanta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Siciliano en sol menor, BWV 1031. Johan Sebastian Bach. Interpretado por: Martina Corredor (piano) y Aylén Sierra (flauta travesera) Martina is a 16-year-old IB Diploma Programme student at IES José Saramago in Madrid. She has always been curious about how different fields connect, from science and technology to philosophy, literature and politics. author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this TEDx talk, Ziana Singh explores two mind-bending mathematical puzzles: the Monty Hall problem, which challenges our intuition about probability, and the Banach–Tarski paradox, which reveals the extraordinary possibilities of abstract mathematics.

Assumptions are an integral (pun intended) part of maths. Without them, we would know, well, nothing. But what happens when perfectly logical reasoning produces conclusions that seem to defy reality?

From surprising probabilities to seemingly impossible mathematics, Ziana invites us to question the assumptions we take for granted—and consider how they shape our understanding of the world and the decisions we make every day.

Because sometimes, the most interesting question isn’t whether the maths is right. It’s what we assumed in the first place.

title: How to Clone an Orange: A Math Paradox  | Ziana Singh | TEDxHartland Intl School

description: Agnieszka Kijas pisze odkąd pamięta. Dziś jest zawodową pisarką i autorką biografii malarzy, ale choć jej świat kręci się wokół sztuki, najbardziej interesują ją ludzie, którzy za nią stoją. Z ich namiętnościami, lękami, wadami i całym życiowym bałaganem, z którego czasem rodzą się arcydzieła. Krytyk sztuki, pisarka, wykładowczyni. Autorka wielu biografii znanych malarzy. Aktywnie promuje sztukę zarówno na żywo, jak i online. Prowadzi podcast, gdzie w lekkim tonie opowiada słuchaczom o najwybitniejszych dziełach, jakie wyszły spod pędzli genialnych malarzy. W środowisku artystycznym jest ceniona nie tylko za profesjonalne podejście, ale także za serce do sztuki. author: TEDx Talks
description: Aneta Wawrzyniak lubi liczby, analizowanie i szukanie zależności. Na co dzień pracuje w logistyce, gdzie porządkuje to, co na pierwszy rzut oka wydaje się skomplikowane. Doświadczenia ostatnich lat nauczyły ją jednak, że nie wszystko, co ważne, można policzyć, przewidzieć i zamknąć w logicznym schemacie. Logistyk i autorka książki. Na co dzień pracuje z liczbami, analizuje i porządkuje rzeczywistość. Poza pracą coraz więcej uwagi poświęca temu, czego nie da się zmierzyć: relacjom, emocjom i ludzkiej obecności. W wystąpieniu „54% Polek i Polaków. Ty też znasz tę historię” oddaje głos osobom współchorującym i pokazuje doświadczenie, o którym wciąż mówi się zbyt rzadko. author: TEDx Talks
description: Emilia Bomba na co dzień jest raczej cicha i spokojna. Nie lubi wychodzić przed szereg, wolne chwile spędza z książkami i nie ukrywa, że uwielbia się przy nich wzruszać. Ma też artystyczną duszę – od dziecka chętnie zatraca się w zajęciach plastycznych. Studentka filologii włosko-angielskiej, miłośniczka górskich wędrówek, via ferrat i dobrych książek, czerpiąca inspiracje z licznych podróży. Wierzy w siłę opowieści zarówno pisanej, jak i wizualnej. Łączy precyzję języka z wrażliwością artystyczną i pasją do tworzenia, z przyjemnością dając jej wyraz w amatorskich próbach graficznych i wspieraniu firm w social mediach. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: To nie jest łatwe, to Ty jesteś w tym dobra | Emilia Bomba | TEDxNikiszowiec Women
